searches: "Womack" NC-14 superintelligence OR "AI safety" OR "artificial intelligence" candidate questionnaire
LaKesha Womack AI extinction OR existential risk
LaKesha Womack AI pause OR moratorium OR "data centers"
grade_reason: No statement by LaKesha Womack about AI of any kind was found in news coverage, her campaign site or candidate profiles since 1 January 2025.
notes: Seven web searches ran; none was refused. She has no house.gov site and has held no prior office. I opened her campaign site (https://www.womack4nc14.com/ and its /issues page: health care, wages, small business, housing, education and workforce, federal spending, institutions, rural investment including broadband, democracy, equity, international diplomacy; no mention of AI), the WFAE candidate questionnaire (2026-09-22), the WFAE profile (2026-10-29), the Alternet profile and her branch.vote page. None contains anything she said about AI, data centers or China. The WFAE profile mentions AI and data centers only in describing her opponent Tim Moore's questionnaire. I did not open the PBS and WSOC video interviews, so I could not check whether AI came up in them. Name searches return other people (Kevin Womack, Kesha Williams), and none of those results is about her. No search was restricted to an official site because she has none; her campaign site was opened directly instead. No source shows her backing the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, and as a first-time candidate she could not have co-sponsored it.
